title: Startup Sues Apple in India Over Contact Feature
excerpt: A U.S. startup has filed a lawsuit against Apple in India, seeking millions in damages over a tap-to-share contacts feature.
body_html:
A U.S. startup has filed a legal case against Apple in India, focusing on the company's tap-to-share contacts feature. The litigation includes a request for 162 million dollars in damages.

Additionally, the startup is pursuing an injunction that would affect the import of iPhones and Apple Watches into the Indian market. The dispute centers around the technology used for sharing contacts between devices.
